headline: Central Bank of Nigeria Offers N800 Billion in Treasury Bills
summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria offered N800 billion in Treasury bills as banks' placements at the Standing Deposit Facility reached N6.98 trillion.
why: Central bank Treasury bill auctions manage domestic liquidity levels and absorb excess cash reserves held by commercial banks.

impacts.name: Banking
impacts.why: Large Treasury bill issuance absorbs surplus banking system liquidity, influencing short-term yields and interbank lending rates.

why_moved: Large-scale issuance absorbs massive commercial bank deposit surpluses, altering short-term debt instrument supply.
